recognition.title: Revenue recognition
recognition.postingHint: Recognition posts only from the central run on the Revenue page — this card is progress data, not a posting action.

recognition.recognitionWarning: Override saved; recognition was not fully updated
recognition.mapAccountsHint: Map the Unbilled receivable and Project revenue control accounts in Company & Accounting to activate project revenue recognition.

table.emptyDescription: Pick another stage, or clear the search.

billRun.title: Bill run
billRun.description: Prepare a draft prebill for every selected project with unbilled work through the cutoff. Each prebill is reviewed before it becomes an invoice.
billRun.submit: Prepare {count, plural, one {# prebill} other {# prebills}}
billRun.created: {count, plural, =0 {No prebills prepared} one {# prebill prepared} other {# prebills prepared}}

notice.withCustomer: Sent to the customer for review {sent}. Not opened yet.
notice.withCustomerViewed: Sent to the customer for review {sent}. Opened {viewed}.
notice.postInvoice: Invoice {invoiceNumber} is a draft. Post it, then send it from here with its backup.

wipBilling.lockedAlert: Lines are locked once a prebill is submitted. Reopen it to make changes; it will be approved again.

preview.title: Invoice preview
preview.taxNote: Tax is calculated when the invoice is created.

reopen.title: Reopen prebill
reopen.description: Reopening returns the prebill to draft and discards its approval and any customer decision.

void.title: Void prebill
void.description: Voiding releases its work back to unbilled. The worksheet and its trail are kept.

send.title: Send to customer for review
send.description: The customer reviews this billing in the customer portal, then accepts it or requests changes line by line.

deliver.title: Send invoice
deliver.description: Email the posted invoice to the customer with its backup packet attached.

panels.recipientHelp: Leave blank to use the customer's email on file.

duplicates.title: Duplicate projects
duplicates.description: Projects sharing a source reference, name and customer, or job number. Choose the survivor per group, preview the impact, then merge.

duplicates.name: Name
duplicates.merge: Merge ({count, plural, one {# reference} other {# references}})
duplicates.moveCount: {count, plural, one {# reference} other {# references}} will move.
duplicates.impactNote: Merges refuse when lines on non-draft documents, change-order numbers, or budget cells collide. The merged project deactivates with a pointer to its survivor.
